 Asset Description : 
 An air dryer, specifically a heat of compression drum type, is an industrial equipment used to dry compressed air. It works by using the heat from the compressed air itself to remove moisture from the air. The main components of an air dryer, heat of compression drum type, include the inlet filter, aftercooler, heat exchanger (which uses a desiccant to absorb moisture from the compressed air), separator (which removes the moisture from the air and stores it for disposal), receiver (which stores the dried air for use in various applications), compressor (which compresses the dried air and sends it back out to the system), and the heat of compression drum (where the moisture is absorbed from the compressed air using the heat from the compressed air). This configuration allows for efficient and reliable drying of compressed air.

Additionally, the inlet filter removes any large particles or contaminants from the air before it enters the dryer, ensuring that the dried air is of high quality. The aftercooler cools the hot compressed air from the compressor before it enters the heat exchanger, preventing damage to the heat exchanger and improving its overall efficiency. The separator also ensures that the moisture is removed from the air and stored for disposal, reducing the environmental impact of the air dryer.
